# HAProxy — custom-to-root-context-sse

Proxy at /app/, app at root /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The prefix strip and the two response rewrites are unchanged from the WebSocket sibling; the one added line denies an upgrade with 501.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/custom-to-root-context-sse/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# templates/strip-prefix.cfg plus a refusal to upgrade: proxy at /app/, app at
# the backend root, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# The prefix translation is unchanged — SSE is an ordinary HTTP GET that streams
# text/event-stream, and the client-to-server messages are XHR POSTs to the same
# path, so both ride the same rules as everything else. What changes is the one
# deny below, which is why this scenario has a file of its own rather than
# mounting the shared template.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    # HAProxy relays an upgrade with no configuration at all and has no keyword
    # to stop it, so the refusal is written out. The Apache and NGINX siblings
    # achieve the same by omission; the 501 here comes from the proxy rather
    # than from Atmosphere.
    http-request deny deny_status 501 if { req.hdr(Upgrade) -m found }

    acl is_app path /app
    acl is_app path_beg /app/
    http-request deny deny_status 404 unless is_app

    http-request replace-path ^/app/?(.*) /\1

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    http-response replace-header Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/(.*) \1/app/\2
    # Anchored on the end of the value: Tomcat writes `Path=/; HttpOnly`, and a
    # regex expecting another path segment after the slash matches nothing.
    http-response replace-header Set-Cookie (.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/(;.*)?$ \1/app\2
    server vaadin vaadin:8080
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
